name: Tidal Wave (Rogue Genius Games)
body:
School conjuration (creation) [water]; Level druid 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

DESCRIPTION

As aqueous orb, but colossal, deals 6d6, passes 30-foot walls, and affects gargantuan targets.
